metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows 4 easy ways to quick eliminate a tension headache. 

A major cause of headaches is due to a build up of muscle tension and stress in the upper back and neck. These exercises are going to focus on quickly relieving this tension, which may offer headache relief within 30 seconds.

Each exercise works differently, they're going to target different muscles. To get the best results, go through them all and use what gives you the most relief.

Let us know what exercise gives you the most tension headache relief!
